mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_session_materialized (session_id, payload) VALUES (#{sessionId}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB))
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, model_id, state, thinking, resource_version, created_at, updated_at, cwd, parent_session_id, metadata::text AS metadata, active_leaf_id FROM t_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

SELECT id, agent_id, model_id, state, thinking, resource_version, created_at, updated_at, cwd, parent_session_id, metadata::text AS metadata, active_leaf_id FROM t_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT next_seq FROM t_session_sequences WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sessions SET state = 'running', active_leaf_id = #{activeLeafId}, resource_version = resource_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND state = 'idle'
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE current_path ( session_id, id, entry_seq, parent_id, type, timestamp, payload ) AS ( SELECT entry.session_id, entry.id, entry.entry_seq, entry.parent_id, entry.type, entry.timestamp, entry.payload FROM t_session_entries entry JOIN t_sessions session ON session.id = entry.session_id AND session.active_leaf_id = entry.id WHERE session.id = #{sessionId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.session_id, parent.id, parent.entry_seq, parent.parent_id, parent.type, parent.timestamp, parent.payload FROM t_session_entries parent JOIN current_path child ON child.session_id = parent.session_id AND child.parent_id = parent.id ) SELECT session_id, id, entry_seq, parent_id, type, timestamp, payload::text AS payload FROM current_path WHERE entry_seq > #{afterSeq} AND ( type IN ( 'user.message', 'assistant.message.completed', 'tool.result', 'session.model.changed', 'session.thinking.changed', 'session.compaction.completed' ) OR (#{includeThinking} = TRUE AND type = 'assistant.thinking.completed') ) ORDER BY entry_seq LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE current_path ( session_id, id, entry_seq, parent_id, type, timestamp, payload ) AS ( SELECT entry.session_id, entry.id, entry.entry_seq, entry.parent_id, entry.type, entry.timestamp, entry.payload FROM t_session_entries entry JOIN t_sessions session ON session.id = entry.session_id AND session.active_leaf_id = entry.id WHERE session.id = #{sessionId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.session_id, parent.id, parent.entry_seq, parent.parent_id, parent.type, parent.timestamp, parent.payload FROM t_session_entries parent JOIN current_path child ON child.session_id = parent.session_id AND child.parent_id = parent.id ) SELECT session_id, id, entry_seq, parent_id, type, timestamp, payload::text AS payload FROM current_path WHERE entry_seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY entry_seq LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sessions SET model_id = #{modelId}, thinking = #{thinking}, resource_version = resource_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND state = 'idle'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_session_cleanup_task (session_id, state, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT session_id FROM t_session_cleanup_task WHERE (state IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (state = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at <= #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY created_at, session_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_session_cleanup_task SET state = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE t_session_cleanup_task SET state = 'RETRY', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND state = 'RUNNING'
